title: ZTIE safe-reject outcome data contract (v1)
description: The derived safe-reject OUTCOME produced by the Story 1.4 reject handler for one intake artifact, and the shape allowed to cross the Forensic -> Hub boundary as a terminal-outcome update (RD-013). A safe-reject records that an artifact was refused cleanly because it could not be routed to any Phase-2 inspection lane. It is a TERMINAL PROCESSING OUTCOME, NOT a safety verdict and NOT a forward-to-PDE decision - there is no verdict/safe/approved/forward field; the human verdict is Hub-side/human-gated (Phase 4). Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256.

contract_version.description: Reject-contract schema version. Pinned so the Hub validator rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this rejection is for. The Hub upserts the terminal outcome onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body. Integrity key.

rejected_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) when the safe-reject decision was made in Forensic.

rejection.description: The terminal outcome and the reason. A PROCESSING OUTCOME only - never a verdict or a forward decision.

pipeline_outcome.description: The terminal pipeline outcome. Always SAFE_REJECTED for this contract. Distinct from the human verdict (PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE) which is Phase 4.

reason.description: Why the artifact was safe-rejected. A closed enum.

artifact_class.description: The class label that triggered the rejection (from the 1.2 classifier / 1.3 router).

notes.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable diagnostic note. Never raw content.
